rv.q: When all the elements come together (including a score by co-composer/sound designers Olanrewaju Adelowe and Kevin O’Donnell), “The Snow Queen” delivers a seasonal delight with an evergreen message.
Filled with excellent acting and some unbelievable life-size puppets, this is a wintertime story with an important message for us all year long.
Vero's performance is subtle but powerful, bringing you to tears with just a look.
For families seeking a shard of self-reflection to offset seasonal indulgence, The Snow Queen may just be the ticket.
They are amazing and worth going to see this show for.

cn.t: Critics praise this modern adaptation of Hans Christian Andersen's fairy tale for its timely environmental themes and family-friendly magic, calling it an enchanting addition to Chicago's holiday theater offerings.
